summary: Groups related buttons, either spaced apart or joined into a segmented control.
whenToUse: Related actions on the same object (duplicate, archive, delete).
Quick format choices in a toolbar.
whenNotToUse: For a persistent selection: use ToggleGroup.

props.name: attached
props.description: Joins the buttons so they share borders.

keyboard.action: Each button is an independent tab stop.

accessibility: Does not add arrow-key navigation: it is a plain grouping.
responsive: Without attached, buttons wrap; with attached, use short labels or orientation="vertical" on mobile.
commonMistakes: Using it for selected states: the buttons do not expose aria-pressed.
